leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a branded type for currency using TypeScript's intersection types
Construct a type guard function to validate currency values at runtime
Apply the branded currency type to function parameters and return types
Manipulate currency values while preserving type safety through helper functions
Configure a TypeScript project to recognize nominal typing patterns
Integrate the branded currency type with existing primitive number operations
Initialize variables with the branded currency type using type assertions
